units: <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 31:17">Ex. R. s. 31</cite> (ref. to <he>כריתי</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 50:5">Gen. L, 5</cite>, v. <cite ref="K01095"><he>כָּרָה</he></cite>) <he>נטל … ועשה אותו כ׳</he> he (Jacob) took all the money he possessed and made a pile of it; <he>כ׳ של דינרין וכ׳</he> a pile of denars have I given to Esau.

<cite ref="Mishnah Terumot 3:5">Ter. III, 5</cite>. Y. ib. I, 40ᵇ bot. <he>הבקיר כֶּרְיוֹ</he> (not <he>כריי</he>) if a man renounced possession of his pile (store) of grain. Ib. IV, 42ᵈ top <he>לפטור את כִּירְיוֹ</he> to discharge the duty of T’rumah for his entire store.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Gittin 7:1:5">Y. Gitt. VII, 48ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>תרם את כִּירְייוֹ</he> if he gave T’rumah for his store; a. fr.—Pl. <he>כְּרָיִים</he>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 3:3:2">Y. Shek. III, end, 47ᶜ</cite> <he>אילו שני כ׳ וכ׳</he> if it were a case of two piles for which a person had discharged T’rumah &c.
